0x0008D2.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x000904.en: 「With the strength I have now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000975.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0009FD.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000A77.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000AA6.en: 「Tch!! What a lousy way to bow out!」

0x000B5E.en: 「Well, well...@　how uncool of me, geez!」

0x000C27.en: 「Kh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000C62.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This is no fun...」

0x000CB6.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000DA0.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000E07.en: 「This is the end for me... the rest is on you.」

0x000E39.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is where it ends!」

0x000E75.en: 「Nngh! So they got the better of me...」

0x000EB3.en: 「No good, took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000F00.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F3E.en: 「Aah! I leave the rest to you!」

0x001030.en: 「Ngh... so I'm to become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010E7.en: 「Ow, ow, ow... I give. I miscalculated.」

0x00116C.en: 「Ngh... rgh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001220.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001255.en: 「Damn it! Is this all the strength I've got...!」

0x001299.en: 「I can't fight any longer! Pulling back!」

0x001312.en: 「Ngh... you're as good as they say.」

0x001341.en: 「To go down in a place like this...@ I'm still not good enough...!」

0x00138F.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001479.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0014B7.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x0014E6.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x001571.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001795.en: 「Guhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A39.en: 「Target decelerating further. It will enter visual range shortly.」

0x001A86.en: 「We tried hailing them,@ but there's no response.」

0x001B0A.en: 「No, apparently there were no visitors scheduled.」

0x001B4E.en: 「Well, barring an emergency,@ nobody shows up this early in the morning.」

0x001BCC.en: 「Here it comes! Combat stations, just in case!」

0x001C03.en: (We finally made it to the <Tesla Leicht Institute>...@ And the Steel Dragon Squadron's units are here too...)

0x001CB6.en: 「The right arm looks like... a Revolving Stake.@ The left is a triple-barreled machine cannon...」

0x001D79.en: 「I never heard about a sister unit being developed.@ Is it a copy...?」

0x001DE8.en: 「Even so, the shoulders are lightly armored.@ That'd make attitude control easier than the@ Alteisen, but what worries me is the torso...」

0x001E96.en: 「More to the point, who's piloting it?」

0x001F1A.en: 「I have no intention of engaging you.@ My name is Ariel Org...」

0x001F85.en: 「I belonged to Beta Saber, a unit of the@ Gaia Sabers, a special ops force under the@ direct command of the <Earth Federation> president.」

0x002135.en: 「To tell you part of the truth about the@ Gaia Sabers...」

0x002197.en: 「My machine, the Flickerei Geist,@ will serve as proof.」

0x0021F0.en: 「To think you'd desert your own organization@ just to tell us something...@ That's hardly reassuring.」

0x002283.en: 「But we can't just take you at your word.」

0x0022B4.en: 「Understandable. I'll disarm now and@ hand over the Flickerei Geist.@ I leave the method of inspection to you.」

0x00238B.en: 「Everyone, I've decided to accept her offer.」

0x0023F0.en: 「That's indispensable to a scientist, Raji.@ Besides, that machine's torso...@ I'm curious about what looks like a core inside.」

0x0024DB.en: (To take notice of the Fau Kern so quickly...@ Just as Dr. Wong said, if it's them...)

0x00255E.en: 「A cluster of high-speed objects is closing in!@ They look like humanoid mobile weapons!」

0x00263F.en: 「That's right.@ I can't let you get away after shooting@ Eric Wong and deserting.」

0x0026E2.en: 「You didn't finish the job. He's alive.@ Thanks to that, we tracked you down right away.」

0x00275C.en: (If it means the doctor won't be suspected, then that's fine...)

0x0028A7.en: (To think he's alive... and acting alongside@ the Steel Dragon Squadron...)

0x00290F.en: 「Heh, a deserter... your luck holds out.」

0x002965.en: 「You didn't know?@ He was a Gaia Sabers soldier,@ same as Ariel.」

0x002A43.en: 「Hmph, so you've lost your memory.@ The price of trying to escape by@ self-destructing, I suppose.」

0x002B05.en: 「I'm Duvan Org.@ Captain of Beta Saber, Gaia Sabers.」

0x002BAA.en: 「I have no wish to fight you.@ My objective is to detain the deserters.」

0x002C06.en: 「Duvan, I won't return to the Gaia Sabers.@ I've learned the truth...@ about Dr. Ozunu, about the Fau Kern...」

0x002D56.en: 「Heh, hah... I see... so that's how it was.@ Now it makes sense.」

0x002E70.en: 「I am. If the Fau Kern displays even greater power,@ it can fulfill the role originally@ granted to Idealant.」

0x002F1E.en: 「And I'll stand at the top,@ and in time, the Gaia Sabers... and then...」

0x002F8C.en: 「Duvan... Project Idealants was twisted@ against Dr. Ozunu's will.」

0x00301E.en: 「Ozunu was the one who was twisted.@ Isn't that why the man was purged?」

0x0030AE.en: 「I don't know who filled your head with what...@ but I won't allow you to defy me.」

0x003110.en: 「Beta 1 to all units.@ Ariel and... Ing, was it.@ Detain those two.」

0x0031B3.en: 「I said I've no wish to fight you.@ This is an internal Gaia Sabers matter.」

0x003227.en: 「Even so, isn't this too heavy-handed!?@ You haven't even asked Ing what he wants!」

0x00329F.en: 「No need to ask what he wants. This time, I'll capture them without fail.@ And the moment you turn your blades on us,@ you become traitors.」

0x003354.en: 「The Gaia Sabers answer only to the Federation President.@ Defying them is treason against him and the government.@ Expect grave charges.」

0x003424.en: 「It's not a threat, it's a warning.@　Ignore it, and you'll lose more than your standing as@　Federation soldiers and citizens.」

0x0034D2.en: 「...So we should expect life in prison, or a firing squad?」

0x00352B.en: 「Correct.@　But stay quiet where you are, and you won't be charged,@　nor face any such punishment.」

0x0035AF.en: 「You can't just spring that on us...!」

0x0035EF.en: 「All of you, do not touch the Gaia Sabers.」

0x003639.en: 「If they struck first, fine. But act recklessly and@ this won't stay your problem alone--@ the Steel Dragons will be dragged in too.」

0x0036ED.en: 「So you're telling us to just stand here and watch!?」

0x003736.en: 「Yes. This isn't some alien force or DC remnant.@　It's an organization on our own side. In this situation,@　the law is on their side.」

0x0037D2.en: 「Everyone, I appreciate the concern, but it's not needed.@　This is my fight... I'll get through it on my own.」

0x003846.en: 「Get through it? You mean to beat me?@　With that failure of a Geist?」

0x0038F5.en: 「Duvan Org... I won't follow you either.」

0x003961.en: 「Even if the Gaia Sabers might be the key to@　bringing back my memories... something tells me@　I shouldn't go with them.」

0x003A0F.en: 「Then all the more reason to fight!」

0x003A34.en: 「I want to know the past I lost...@　But I can't let that keep dragging all of you@　into more trouble.」

0x003AD9.en: 「Fiona,@　Brooklyn and the others can't move, but we can!」

0x003B29.en: 「No. If we do, Tesla Labs won't come out unscathed.」

0x003B9A.en: 「Calm down, and look at the monitor.@　There's a message from the Director.」

0x003C25.en: 「I see, if Ratsel and the others come back...!」

0x003C6E.en: 「...To the Gaia Sabers, they're targets to be pursued.@　It pains me to push this burden onto them...」

0x003D2E.en: 「The rest is buying time.@　Rob, what about the other plan?」

0x003D8B.en: 「She's fired up. The coating cloak mount and@　the remote setup will be done shortly.」

0x003E1D.en: 「But with the patch armor held on@　by AD tape like this...」

0x003E8E.en: 「If it comes to it, we send her out by remote.@ That'll buy us a little time. Hurry it along.」

0x003F1A.en: 「...Ariel,@　you know about my past, don't you?」

0x004059.en: 「You'd challenge my Ares with that defective piece?」

0x004093.en: 「That's exactly why I can control it.@　But the Ares' Fau Kern...!」

0x004101.en: 「I told you, it's a power worthy of me!」

0x004147.en: 「If you want to know your past, obey me quietly.」

0x004190.en: 「I won't go back to the Gaia Sabers...@　to a place I don't even remember!」

0x0041F2.en: 「Damn you, a mere deserter, how dare you!@　Then so be it...!」

0x004242.en: 「Hmph, not bad.@　But I'm done wasting time on this.」

0x00429B.en: 「The rest of you, fall back and cut off their retreat!」

0x004320.en: 「It's not as sluggish as you think.」
